LanguageData.SSC_Sensitivity_Tip: This body retains its micromachine instructions. The current chain stage limits the effective level. A master's death does not cancel instructions in a valid chain.
LanguageData.SSC_Sensitivity_ConfigInvalid: Invalid sensitivity configuration; existing settings can still be turned off.
LanguageData.SSC_Sensitivity_BodyUnavailable: This body cannot execute its micromachine instructions.
LanguageData.SSC_Sensitivity_PersonalityUnavailable: Control is suspended during personality replacement or while the body is hollow.
LanguageData.SSC_Sensitivity_NotSlave: This pawn does not currently have the SSC slave role; instructions are suspended.
LanguageData.SSC_Sensitivity_NoChain: No valid chain; instructions are suspended.
LanguageData.SSC_Sensitivity_NotEditable: Only a living, editable body belonging to the player can be adjusted.
LanguageData.SSC_Sensitivity_LevelLocked: This level is locked by the current chain stage; the saved choice is retained.
